## New this pass (planning pass ~103) — most significant finding in weeks

**Root-caused a fifth, distinct harness-reliability bug that is very likely the dominant cause
of the whole "PASSED/verified but gate says not committed" pattern documented across #279:
`origin/main` and the local working checkout have genuinely diverged (`git status`: `ahead 26,
behind 1`), and `scripts/dispatcher.sh`'s `git push origin HEAD` calls have been silently
failing non-fast-forward ever since, with no fetch/merge/retry logic to recover.**

- **Live evidence**: local has 26 unpushed commits (work for #280, #264, #265, #270, #271,
  #274, #302, and more), `origin/main` has one commit (`5102783`, closes #180) local's fork
  point predates. `grep -c "non-fast-forward" logs/dispatcher.log` = **96 historical
  occurrences**. This pass alone, #274 (`agent-review`, karen PASSED repeatedly with clean
  verdict.txt evidence) hit this exact rejection 5 times in 90 minutes (08:53-10:24Z), each a
  real ~$0.34-0.70 karen run cost with zero net progress.
- **Important open risk this implies**: several issues on this thread already closed by manual
  lead re-verification (#167, #272, #263, #160, #265, #271) were confirmed by checking the
  commit existed on local `HEAD` — but that does **not** guarantee the commit ever reached
  `origin/main`. A real possibility that a meaningful slice of "closed" work only exists in this
  local checkout right now. Flagged as a follow-up audit once the fix lands.
- **Also confirmed live**: the agent Bash tool blocks plain `git merge` with "This command
  requires approval" — same restriction family as #294's `git rm` finding, a different git
  subcommand. `git fetch`/`git commit`/`git push` (no merge) are NOT blocked. This is why the
  fix must live in `scripts/dispatcher.sh` itself (runs outside the agent sandbox via the
  dispatcher loop), not something any worker/lead can run live.
- **Action taken**: created **#305** (`agent-todo`, unblocked, no formal dependency on #283
  despite touching the same `commit_verified_issue()` function — scoped narrowly to just the
  push call sites, with an explicit note to check #283's landing state first to avoid
  conflicts) — wraps every `git push origin HEAD` call with fetch + `merge --ff-only` (falling
  back to a real merge, aborting cleanly on genuine conflicts rather than force-pushing) +
  retry. Posted full evidence as addenda on both **#279** and **#294**.
- Rest of the board unchanged from pass ~102's fresh census: 12 `agent-todo` (now 13 with
  #305), 18 `agent-backlog`, #274 still the only `agent-review` (now understood to likely be
  stuck purely on this push bug, not a real gap — karen's own verdict.txt is a clean PASS
  modulo one INCONCLUSIVE full-suite-timeout note), 2 open questions (#279/#294, both freshly
  updated this pass, still non-blocking), zero untriaged/triage/inbox items.
- `depends_on` graph re-walked: unchanged conclusions from pass ~102 — zero promotions due
  (#292/#291→#290 open; #289→#288 open; #288→#287 open; #284→#283/#282 open; #282→#283 open;
  #277→#276 open; #268→#267 open).

**Net board effect:** 1 new issue (#305, `agent-todo`), 2 comments (#279, #294), 0 closures, 0
promotions. Next pass should check whether #305 gets picked (would auto-resolve #274's push
gate on the very next karen/worker push attempt) and, once it lands, run the follow-up audit

## What this project is

Project Origins: a persistent ecosystem simulation where players guide life evolution through
species creation and environmental stewardship. MVP shipped as a deterministic, local-first
evolution sandbox (Phases 1–7, all closed). On 2026-08-11 the client approved a **Crisis-Response
Reframe pivot**: the game becomes an active loop (remote alien operator directing a scout +
interventions on a resource-scarce planet, loop = Explore → Fix → Study → Watch) instead of a
passive ecosystem viewer, built on top of the same simulation engine. Phase 0 (cheap vertical
slice proving the loop) and Phase A (core systems: save/load, win-condition gate, Tier 2/3 LLM
crisis responses, command validation) both shipped and closed. The legacy pre-pivot engine
backlog (soil/water, evolution-truth evidence, Three.js render pipeline, engine-scale/worker
threading, knowledge progression, branch-and-compare, disaster events, etc.) was re-opened
alongside the pivot per client direction and is what most of the current board represents. Full
pivot rationale: `SPEC.md` → "Pivot: Crisis-Response Reframe" (source plan:
`swift-hopping-codd.md`, client-side, not in this repo).

## Known live risk (not a new issue — tracked via #305/#284, just keeping it visible)

The local checkout is currently `ahead 33, behind 1` of `origin/main` (confirmed pass ~115,
growing every pass — was `ahead 26` when #305 was first filed).
Every `git push origin HEAD` from `commit_verified_issue()` in `scripts/dispatcher.sh` fails
non-fast-forward until #305 lands, which causes clean karen PASSes to be reported as "Verified
but not committed" and re-cycle (real $ cost, no progress) — already hit #274, #265, #272, #263,
#160, #167 across recent passes, all manually verified and closed by the lead in the meantime.
#305 is the highest-numbered ready `agent-todo` issue, which under the still-unfixed
WORK-selector (#284, itself gated behind #283/#282) means it's the most exposed to starvation.
No lever exists from planning to force pick order — flagging for visibility only.
